verdict.rationale: A public company-register portal could plausibly publish an API with official SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows only web search interfaces, a publication platform and an unbinding structured-information service. It never mentions an official SDK or client library, and the llms.txt probe returned 404, so there is no evidence of SDK support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
